planning_notes: No serial communication was specified in the provided requirements; therefore no serial_channels are generated.

elapsed_ms is used to implement: initial silence until first accumulated 3000ms, then tone bursts of 100ms at 1000Hz every accumulated 3000ms; pause (button D2 low on press edge) immediately silences tone while preserving accumulated runtime and remaining burst time; resume continues without restarting the full cycle. All business logic and pause/remaining-time bookkeeping belong in the SysML model.

Button D2 is configured as INPUT_PULLUP; the model boolean is defined as true when the button is pressed. Long-press/release do not toggle; only press edge toggles pause state and pause persists until the next press edge.
tone_output initial is set to 31 (catalog silence behavior as permitted by tone_output: 0 or 31..65535). Model must drive 0 to keep silent and 1000Hz for 100ms when scheduled.

interfaces.name: io_1

interfaces.meaning: Actual delta since previous control step (used for 3000ms accumulation and 100ms tone burst timing tolerance budgeting)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
蜂鸣器（D6）每 3 秒响一次，按钮（D2）暂停/恢复
